svg.text: I am Olivier J. Caron, professor in the Department of Geography at UQAM (Université du Québec à Montréal) and
research affiliate at the Illinois State Geological Survey. Trained as a Quaternary geologist, I design
geomatics analysis models and geospatial data dissemination tools, from 3D mapping of Chicago's glacial deposits
Since 2026, I have also been building a network of historical atlases of French America: interactive maps where
every place is dated, geolocated with its degree of certainty and tied to its sources (books, parish registers,
Currently: working through sources on French speakers in the Mississippi Valley and the American West
Research: Quaternary geology, 3D modelling, hydrogeology, risk geomatics
Teaching: GIS, geographic data structures, visualization, emergency geomatics
